node.title: Re: Parsing incorrect html
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It appears that [mod://Mojo::DOM] can handle that particular example HTML, this prints "

this is a test

" and "

this is a second test

":

use warnings; use strict; use Mojo::DOM; my $dom = Mojo::DOM->new( do { local $/; } ); for my $e ($dom->find('html html > body p')->each) { print $e->to_string, "\n"; }

Update: Switched the above from finding the

tag to the

tags, to show that it does not get confused like in your example. Update 2: Added newline for clarity.
